status: Proposed M1 presentation; actual persisted features and influence values remain authoritative

geometry.origin: One SVG content-box origin shared by polygons, markers, footprints, routes and pointer conversion; panel borders sit outside this coordinate space
geometry.positions: Use persisted feature Position and RadiusX/RadiusY. A feature is never snapped to Region.Center. Boundaries and graph routes use exact Layout points
geometry.footprints: Axis-aligned generation influence ellipses only. No invented cloud contour, physical radius, mass unit, sensor range or hazard zone
geometry.scale: Uniform map fit; footprint radii scale with coordinates; marker/stroke/hit target/text sizes stay in screen pixels

interaction.system: Star centre selects actual associated system; Star influence details is a separate inspector action
interaction.blackHole: Dark core plus broken lavender ring; selects feature inspector
interaction.nebula: Faint teal ellipse plus distinct diamond centre; centre selects feature, footprint fill does not intercept region picking
interaction.candidate: Open bracket and candidate-details action from system inspector; no ownership fill
interaction.collisions: Star centres take priority. Region inspection lists actual contributing features as independent reachable buttons so overlapped feature centres remain accessible
interaction.keyboard: Enter/Space activates each feature; retain focus after redraw; separate dashed focus indicator
interaction.toggles: Features toggles feature visuals; Influence areas toggles persisted support ellipses; Density causes adds factual selected-region explanation. These controls never regenerate data

layout.explanation: Selected region shows actual capped density and persisted contributing feature names/values. State provisional generation tuning and separate unit crossing cost in plain language
layout.reviewMode: Full generated-map review, not future civilization-filtered campaign knowledge
